_comment: SmartCuff GUI update manifest. Fetched by the installed GUI over plain
public HTTPS -- there is deliberately NO credential in the client. See
README.md for why an embedded token was rejected.
This file is the ONLY thing the updater needs to read. Keep it small and
keep it valid JSON: a malformed manifest must fail soft in the client, but
there is no reason to rely on that.
The installer is a GitHub Release asset rather than a repository blob.
Keep installer_url version-specific: an existing manifest must always
resolve to the exact immutable bytes whose size and SHA-256 it declares.
notes:
Smart Cuff Default v3.1.342 / firmware rev27v-followup-324

Ordinary inflation now measures the connected load in the first second, reducing
wrist-cuff startup demand while retaining full pump authority for a slow load.
Refill reuses its same-cycle response and fits a complete measured beat. Ordinary
deflation starts the original ramp with existing feedforward/proportional
correction and zero integral. Orderly safe serial close drains the old UART
stream and waits for a matching nonce acknowledgement. Strict CRC rejection,
raw evidence, calibration, branch presets and safety gates remain active.

Device D wrist-cuff/syringe bench: protected flash preserved all saved device
state. Required ten-minute seed213 soak completed six trials/all five presets,
26,130/26,130 = 100% telemetry delivery, 330,570 native NI samples, zero
gaps/backtracks, exact mirrors and whole-wire CRC pass. Actual production START
completed all three non-CVP products, 20,814/20,814 = 100% delivery and 236,280 NI
samples. All original inflation and startup-deflation screens passed. Six orderly
close/reopen trials passed with no invalid complete DATA frame.

Full controller qualification remains FAIL. High Max's original narrow quiet
landing screen measured +2.244 mmHg against +/-2. The Smart host-time actuator
screen included a pre-entry pump frame; separate serial ordering confirms every
quiet-hold post-entry frame pump0/valve100, while electrical edges are unobserved.
CVP ramp RMS remains 7.94/10.53 mmHg. All-band response comparisons retain
nonstationarity/repeatability failures and LOW preparation rejection; no new
calibration/SysID profile was adopted. A separate LOW comparison used production's
existing 3.6 mmHg preparation headroom and retained the original quality gates.
It completed four probes: the first repeated response disagreed with discovery,
and the next repeat stopped at the bounded pressure floor. Delivery was
9,877/9,877 = 100%, with 111,920 native NI samples, valid complete DATA CRC,
exact mirrors and verified device-state preservation and safe cleanup.
Larger actual cuffs, independently qualified
pressure/pulse/electrical faults, physical controls and second-PC fleet observations
are unverified. Earlier corruption and failed runs remain in the evidence.

The application update verifies exact URL, byte count and SHA-256 and installs
only through the existing fresh idle/pump-off/vented gate. Protected firmware
alignment preserves calibration. Same-branch historical versions remain selectable.
Unsigned first installation may need More info -> Run anyway in Windows
SmartScreen; the application cannot bypass that Windows prompt.
_channel_note: stable is the only channel today. If a test channel is ever added, publish
a second manifest (version-beta.json) rather than adding branching logic to
the client -- the client stays a dumb fetch-and-compare.
